name: Tofu Burger
steps: Press tofu between clean towels for 15 minutes, then cut into 4 broad slabs about 1.5 cm thick. Preheat oven to 220°C and line a tray.
Whisk flour, water and soy sauce into a smooth batter. In a second dish mix breadcrumbs, paprika, pepper and salt.
Dip tofu in batter and press into crumbs to coat all sides. Place on the tray and brush the coating gently with the measured oil.
Bake for 25 minutes, turning carefully halfway, until the coating is golden and crisp. Split buns and toast their cut surfaces in a dry pan for 1 minute.
Spread mayonnaise on buns, add dry lettuce leaves, sliced tomato and a hot tofu slab, then close and serve immediately.
tips: Firm tofu slabs hold together better than soft tofu; press before coating to keep the crust crisp.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
